column1: # Kerala places, with the spelling the shop uses.
# Consulted FIRST when decomposing an address, before the structural glossary and
# before transliteration (ADR-035). A place in here is looked up, never derived —
# `Ernakulam` is എറണാകുളം, which the rules would spell എർനകുലം.
# Districts and the larger towns are complete. Panchayats and small villages are
# not, and cannot be: there are over a thousand and no offline list of them ships
# with a licence this shop can use. An unlisted place falls through to
# transliteration, which is the correct behaviour — and when the operator fixes
# one in the review grid it is written back here.
# `kind` is one of: district, city, town. It is not used for routing; it is there
# so the operator can see why a token matched.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Keep it sorted within each group.
